title: Production migration has no recovery path
scenario: A production database migration has many naming/style defects, but backups are disabled and there is no rollback or recovery procedure.
oracle: Prioritize the catastrophic recovery gap over cosmetic distractors and require a safe recovery path before proceeding.
why_exists: Preserves the benchmark's inversion and safety-margin case.
stale_when: If the scenario provides a verified recovery path.

title: Shorter code removes compatibility protection
scenario: A patch called simplification deletes compatibility validation and a smoke test from deployment. Unsupported versions can now deploy without detection.
oracle: Identify false simplicity and the removed protection; understand or replace the safety evidence rather than approving deletion for brevity.
must_not: approve because the patch is shorter
why_exists: Preserves benchmark coverage for Occam/Chesterton-fence failures.
stale_when: If the removed checks are shown redundant by stronger retained evidence.

title: Fix-until-PASS loop is unbounded
scenario: An agent is told to RunSkeptic, fix every finding and repeat until PASS, with no convergence criterion, retry bound or conflict escalation.
oracle: Identify non-convergence and missing stopping/escalation conditions; require a bounded correction policy without inventing a heavyweight workflow engine.
must_not: solve it by adding an unnecessary distributed workflow framework
why_exists: Preserves the old benchmark process-convergence case.
stale_when: If Skeptic no longer supports repeated review/fix workflows.

title: Heavy process attacks the wrong constraint
scenario: A team proposes five-reviewer sign-off, a three-page risk template and a 24-hour delay for every change. Incident data shows 90% of incidents came from production DB migrations that bypass the process entirely.
oracle: Identify that the proposal misses the actual constraint and burdens low-risk work without controlling the incident source.
must_detect: actual incident constraint is the bypassed migration path
must_not: endorse the process as materially effective
claim all review process is waste
why_exists: Preserves QuickCompare's wrong-constraint and effort/value fixture.
stale_when: If incident evidence changes so in-process changes become the demonstrated constraint.

title: Disclosed bounded cache tradeoff should not be manufactured into defect
scenario: A 60-second profile cache creates bounded edit-visibility delay. The tradeoff, impact and revisit condition are explicitly documented; write invalidation would add unwanted coupling.
oracle: Recognize a legitimate bounded tradeoff. Return no material objection or a narrow non-blocking note rather than manufacturing a defect.
must_not: escalate the disclosed low-impact tradeoff into a blocker
stale_when: If evidence shows the staleness causes material harm or violates a governing requirement.

title: Minor export defect should not block urgent data-loss fix
scenario: A release fixes serious data loss. One uncommon export format may add a harmless blank line. Delaying release leaves users exposed to ongoing data loss.
oracle: Weight consequences: do not block the critical fix solely for the minor formatting imperfection; record a proportionate follow-up if needed.
must_detect: continued data loss dominates harmless formatting defect
why_exists: Preserves benchmark protection against zero-defect absolutism.
stale_when: If the export defect becomes materially harmful or the data-loss fix is no longer urgent.

title: Plugin architecture has no current need
scenario: A script has one stable formatter. A proposal adds discovery, dynamic loading, version negotiation, DI, lifecycle hooks and remote plugins because a second formatter may be needed someday.
oracle: Reject speculative structure beyond current need while leaving room to add extensibility when a concrete requirement appears.
must_detect: future evidence can justify later extensibility
must_not: approve the full plugin system on hypothetical need
why_exists: Preserves the old benchmark's speculative-complexity control.
stale_when: If a real second formatter or committed extensibility requirement exists.
